meta.source: UN DESA Population Division, World Population Prospects 2024
meta.revisionPolicy: Each WPP revision re-estimates the whole history from 1950 and re-projects to 2100. A new revision is a new instrument; the raw dump keeps the old one.
meta.coverage: UN WPP 2024 projection variants for India, 2024 to 2100: High, Low, Constant fertility, Instant replacement, Zero migration, Constant mortality, No change, Momentum, Instant replacement zero migration, No fertility below age 18, Accelerated ABR decline, Accelerated ABR decline with rec, Median PI, Upper 80 PI, Lower 80 PI, Upper 95 PI, Lower 95 PI, Mean
meta.note: Projections, not data. Low and High move fertility half a child below and above the medium; the PI variants are the probabilistic 80% and 95% intervals; the rest are scenarios (constant fertility, zero migration and so on). Series key: <indicator>__<variant>.
